## Summary

<!-- What does this change, and why? -->

> `data/eol.json` is generated and is overwritten on every rebuild, so pull requests
> that edit it by hand are not merged. To correct a date, a behavior outcome, or
> coverage, please open an Issue with a link to the official AWS documentation (see
> CONTRIBUTING.md). Pull requests are welcome for documentation fixes.
